resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list marks the site gone and the FFLOS register gives the removal date as unknown but says only the foundation remains. The OpenStreetMap point carries building, fire_lookout and name tags with no status, so it does not show a standing lookout. Treated as gone, foundation only.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS register gives substance; the Forest Lookouts page for Valley View has a heading and county but no history entries, so no staffing or fire history is reported. The brief's osm=standing conflict is a misreading, since the OSM node carries no status tag. The 4.3 m height is the 14-foot tower named by FFLOS. The 1968 photo is a caption on the FFLOS page; the image URL was not captured, so no photo entry was added. No source describes current access.
